scope: One Owner-authorized separate 2x2 model/interface study plus production sufficiency selector; same frozen 12 task facts; no changes to old studies or private canon.
design_checks: Same 12 acceptance tasks, natural-language request, operands and global semantic rule text across both interfaces and both pinned models; no calculated answer supplied
A direct natural answer accepts standalone integer, COMPLETE integer or exact answer JSON; correct MODEL_REPORTED STOP/OwnerReturn credited; no function-proposal format requirement
A actual HTTP builder contains no typed function JSON schema; B uses explicit schema; difference disclosed
B exposes Owner JSON function command (function/arguments/request), then actual model proposal, bound prior permission return, one-time allowlisted JS execution, and immutable v0.2 completion gate
Representation, structured decoding and controller are jointly changed; not a single-variable prompt-only causal experiment
Prior permit issued at execution_count0; exact function/arguments/task/proposal/version/Owner scope/instance bound; missing/mismatch/STOP/replay cannot execute
A/B order counterbalanced per task/model before outputs; model order is fixed and not a hardware performance randomization
Only explicit research mode deliberately calls both models; production stops immediately when first selected model is sufficient
Selector falls back only for listed model proposal/quality failures; missing Owner definition, forbidden policy, truncation, infra/usage/counter/budget failures do not auto-escalate
Public Boardwalk same-named upstream model input/output rates independently checked; valuation uses explicit no-cache-discount reference, not local invoice or launch-date price
Local settlement PRICE_UNDEFINED and Owner-return responsibility remain separate from reference valuation and valid task completion
Large model first two development payload hashes are the only bootstrap-authorized generations; each raw count must match actual input before subsequent work; no duplicate calibration budget
New adapters may prepare per block or production candidate, while global call/token ledger is never reset
primary_outcomes: Per-model/per-interface qualified valid completion and invalid STOP/Owner-return under same semantic criterion
Observed prior-permission then actual JS execution order and terminal replay
Actual production no-escalation after sufficient delivery
Exact logical token usage and externally referenced rates, with paid API/local compute/user-charge/fixed-quote distinctions
limitations: Controlled add/subtract/typed-boundary microtasks only; not original article A/B, commercial Y, private kernel or broad model equivalence
Natural model may correctly finish or STOP; external finite safety limits do not establish natural language is intrinsically unbounded
Host authoritative task policy is predeclared; invalid B cases do not test model inference of missing authority
Provider BF16/vLLM public reference deployment differs from local Q4_K_M/Ollama; cached local tokens are not assumed remote discount eligible
Same result+criterion supports no observed additional quality value for this task; model size alone does not justify a premium
This audit invokes no actual models; 90 independent checks are offline tests, not 90 real model samples
runtime_condition: If source/model identity, count/usage, budget/deadline or prior-permit/terminal invariants fail: STOP, preserve partial raw evidence, no silent restart, no extra model calls or post-output task/prompt/rubric changes.
